aas:langStringTextType.aas:text: A site is a delimited geographical area where a legal entity does business (geographical address with geo coordinates). A site always has a primary physical address. It is possible that further physical addresses are specified for the site. P.O. box details are only possible in addition to the physical address. A site has a 1:n relation to addresses, means at least one address is necessary and multiple addresses are possible.

aas:langStringDefinitionTypeIec61360.aas:text: A Part Type represents an item in the Catena-X Bill of Material (BOM) on a type level in a specific version.
The classification ID of the part type according to the corresponding standard definition mentioned in the key value pair.
Optional property describing the classification standard.
Property describing the classification of a part.
Name of the part as assigned by the manufacturer

Part ID as assigned by the manufacturer of the part. The Part ID identifies the part (as designed) in the manufacturer`s dataspace. The Part ID does not reference a specific instance of a part and thus should not be confused with the serial number or batch number.
The part type from which the serialized part has been instantiated.

The identifier of the site according to BPDM. The siteId must be a valid BPN. The BPN is a unique, unchangeable identifier for business partners / company locations from foundation to closure, regardless of the different business relationships / structures between or within the business partners or company locations.
The function of the site in relation to the part (i.e. the activity within the value chain of the part that is performed at the site).
Timestamp, from when the site has the specified function for the given part.
Timestamp, until when the site has the specified function for the given part.

A site is a delimited geographical area where a legal entity does business (geographical address with geo coordinates). A site always has a primary physical address. It is possible that further physical addresses are specified for the site. P.O. box details are only possible in addition to the physical address. A site has a 1:n relation to addresses, means at least one address is necessary and multiple addresses are possible.
The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
